full_prompt_en: A square muted oil-painting-style scene shows a solitary woman crossing a broad sandy open space beside pale weathered buildings and a dark sea. The ground fills most of the lower two-thirds, washed in ochre, warm gray, and cream with a rough granular texture and very little surface detail. Across the left middle distance, a narrow charcoal-blue strip of water meets a pale gray-green sky at a nearly level horizon. At the center-right, clustered beige buildings rise from the sand, their flat walls, small black windows, and one dark arched doorway stated with simple blocky shapes. Their surfaces are mottled and worn, and the mass of architecture partly hides the continuation of the shore. The woman stands slightly right of center in left-facing profile, small in relation to the open ground. Short reddish-brown hair frames her head; she wears a plain white long-sleeved top and a dark calf-length skirt. Her arms hang loosely at her sides, and her feet touch the pale sand in a gentle walking stance. No other prominent person or object interrupts the empty foreground. A long, narrow shadow extends from her feet toward the lower right, giving the otherwise nearly flat ground a firm contact point. Soft low light comes from the left, brightening the white top and the open sand while the buildings and skirt retain subdued shadow. Edges are softly rubbed and the brushwork is fine, dry, and slightly dusty, causing the distant architecture and horizon to settle into the same quiet atmosphere. The overall composition is spare and contemplative, using the small figure, low sea line, and large textured earth-colored field to make solitude and distance visible.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、低调油画式场景描绘一名孤身女子走过宽阔沙色空地，旁边是磨旧的浅色建筑和深色海面。地面占据下方约三分之二，以赭色、暖灰与奶油色薄铺，带粗糙颗粒肌理，表面细节很少。左侧中远景，一条窄炭蓝色水面在几乎水平的地平线上接上浅灰绿色天空。中央偏右，成群米色建筑从沙地升起，平坦墙面、小黑窗和一道深色拱门由简洁块状形体交代。墙面斑驳磨旧，建筑体块也遮住了岸线的延续。女子在中央略右处朝左侧身，相对于敞开地面显得很小。短赤褐发围住头部；她穿朴素白色长袖上衣和深色及小腿的裙子。双臂松弛垂在身旁，双脚以轻缓步态触及浅色沙地。没有其他显眼人物或物件打断空旷前景。一道长而窄的影子从脚下伸向右下，使其他部分近乎平面的地面有了坚定接触点。柔和低角度光从左侧进入，照亮白上衣和开敞沙地，建筑与裙装仍保持低调阴影。边缘轻轻擦模，笔触细、干且略带粉尘感，使远处建筑与地平线落入同一片安静空气。整体构图简约而沉思，以小人物、低海线和大片带肌理的土色地面呈现孤独与距离。
style_prompt_en: The painting relies on broad, lightly weathered fields of ochre, cream, warm gray, and a restrained charcoal-blue accent. Forms are simplified into small dark apertures and quiet blocks, with softened rubbed edges and a fine dry grain across the surface. Most of the lower space remains open and minimally detailed; a narrow horizontal band and a small upright focal shape give it scale. Low side light warms pale areas and creates one modest elongated shadow, while distant planes flatten gently into a hazy atmosphere. Contrast is subdued except for compact dark marks, which hold attention without disrupting the calm. The overall finish is sparse, matte, and contemplative, using empty textured space as strongly as the visible forms.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅绘画依靠宽阔、轻度磨旧的赭色、奶油色和暖灰色域，以及克制的炭蓝色强调。形体被简化为小深色开口和安静块面，边缘经擦磨柔化，表面贯穿细而干的颗粒。下方空间大部分留空且少细节；一条窄水平带和一个小竖形焦点赋予它尺度。低角度侧光温暖浅色区域并形成一道克制的长影，远处平面则轻轻压入朦胧空气。反差总体低调，只有紧凑深痕吸引注意，却不破坏宁静。整体完成面稀疏、哑光而沉思，带肌理的空白空间与可见形体同样有力。
theme_en: A solitary woman crossing a sandy open space beside pale buildings and a dark sea
theme_zh: 孤身女子走过沙色空地，旁有浅色建筑与深色海面
name: David Brayne
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
